source.notes:
The mini-symposium (co-chaired by Stefano Letizia and Julia Gottschall) was held on 25 June 2025, and comprised the following individual presentations:

  • "Sensitivity of the turbulence measurements from ground-based lidars to the beam orientation" by Abdul H. Syed (a)
  • "A Comprehensive Sensitivity Analysis of Wind Lidar Uncertainty Using a Fiber Optic Bench and Monte Carlo Simulation" ny Andrew Black (b)
  • "LARGE-EDDY-SIMULATION-BASED PERFORMANCE EVALUATION OF FLOATING LIDARS - MOTION CORRECTION & WIND PROPERTIES RECONSTRUCTION" by Benjamin Bouvier (c)
  • "Wind Field Reconstruction Using Single Doppler Lidar: A Lagrangian Approach" by Ignace Ransquin (d)

Please note that each document or presentation may have its own license. If in doubt about reusing or citing any of the material presented here, please contact the authors.
source.title: WESC 2025 Mini-Symposium MS#01.8 "Lidars In and Out of Simulations – a collaboration between IEA Tasks 52 and 57"
